content: Root cause: The bug was caused by improper handling of boolean logic in the polling routines for the i40e and i40evf drivers, specifically the misuse of bitwise operators instead of logical operators. This led to incorrect flow control, where certain conditions could be skipped due to short-circuit evaluation. This issue was exacerbated when another patch converted bitwise operations to logical operations without addressing the logic flow properly, making the code less readable and maintainable. The patch rewrites the logic using explicit if statements for better clarity and correctness.
